mostWorthwhile.text: Forming the planet-forming disk brought the inherited rocky and icy dust into a clear picture of how material remains around the growing Sun.

leastWorthwhile.text: The failed cooling combination was less rewarding as progress, though its compatibility feedback helped identify the next options.

surprise.text: I expected hydrogen to bring the protostar directly to sustained fusion, but the young Sun was still powered by contraction and accretion.

arbitrary.text: Combining the young Sun with escaping radiation to create sunlight felt somewhat symbolic; the inspection established compatibility but did not explain why that pairing was needed.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the disk’s temperature differences shape the eventual rocky world and water; that connection to natural processes is interesting.
